hints.title: Cap Battery Contributions
hints.text: If the target running time is T, no individual battery can provide more than T units of charge.

hints.title: Feasibility Condition
hints.text: A target time T is possible if the sum of min(battery, T) across all batteries is at least n * T.

hints.title: Binary Search on Answer Range
hints.text: Binary search T in the range [1, sum(batteries) // n] using the feasibility condition.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating minute-by-minute battery swapping across computers is intractable.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search on running time runs in O(B log(sum/n)) time with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Prove that min(b, T) total energy saturation is necessary and sufficient.
